title: Ring Around the Rosie
sentences: You've heard this nursery rhyme is about the plague.
Rosy rashes, pockets full of posies, and everyone falls down dead.
The rhyme wasn't printed until 1881, centuries after the Black Death.
The plague explanation only appeared in the twentieth century.
caption:
You’ve heard this nursery rhyme is about the plague. There’s no evidence it is.

Full documentary on our YouTube channel. Follow for 3 stories a day.
